items.body:
# Interactive Stream-of-Consciousness Feedback & Live Reading Notes Protocol

## Core Intent
Codify an interactive pair-programming mechanism that allows the developer to capture incremental, stream-of-consciousness reactions as they read long architectural teardowns (PCDAs, specs, audit reports) before reaching discussion, without losing thoughts or feeling constrained by linear reading.

## Proposed Mechanism
1. **Live Reading Note Capture**: Developer reads long dialectics section-by-section and dumps gut reactions as they read ("presentation notes mode").
2. **Non-Judgmental Buffer**: Agent explicitly buffers and reconciles incremental user feedback against later sections without patronizing or dismissing early reactions.
3. **UI Sidecar Tooling**: Potential future N'kai widget or chat command (`/stream-notes` or inline margin notes) allowing paragraph-level reactions.

## Action Route
Approve -> document protocol in docs/history/vibe_coding_field_guide.md and AGY prompt rules.
